name: The Wedding
source:
Get ready for romance, laughs, and wild choices in 'The Wedding,' an interactive game where your choices matter. Fake date, elope, or sabotage a wedding – your decisions will shape the story. 

This isn't your usual love story – it's for readers who love a good twist. In this game, you can take revenge on a bully, rekindle with an ex, fake date your business partner, neighbor, or the cute firefighter who is also your friend with benefits. And if you're up for it, you can even run away with the bride or groom if you can make them fall in love with you.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2050140095/the-wedding-1]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
准备好在“婚礼”这款互动游戏中迎接浪漫、欢笑和疯狂的选择，你的选择至关重要。假约会、私奔或破坏婚礼——你的决定将影响故事的发展。

这不是常见的爱情故事——这是为喜欢精彩曲折的读者准备的。在这个游戏中，你可以向恶霸复仇，与前任重燃旧好，假装约会你的商业伙伴、邻居，或者是可爱的消防员，同时也是你的朋友，并为你带来好处。如果你愿意的话，如果你能让新娘或新郎爱上你，你甚至可以和他们私奔。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2050140095/the-wedding-1]Kickstarter[/url]]
